metadata.description: Plugins from Joel Stevick's Claude Code Shorts.

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Paste a link to a GitHub pull request or GitLab merge request and get a review: bugs, security problems, missing tests, worst first, with file and line.

plugins.name: commit-and-pr
plugins.description: Write the commit message and the pull request description from your actual changes, in your repository's own style.

plugins.name: write-tests
plugins.description: Write the tests for your change, in your project's style, and prove each one can fail.

plugins.name: free-disk-space
plugins.description: Free up disk space on a Mac: moves what rebuilds itself to the Trash, and asks about big files that might matter.

plugins.name: fix-bug
plugins.description: Reproduce a bug with a failing test, find the cause, fix it, and prove the fix.

plugins.name: spec-first
plugins.description: Turn a request into a task file of checkable rules and the tests that check them, get your OK, then build until the tests pass, with the tests locked so they can't be edited to pass.

plugins.name: update-docs
plugins.description: Checks every claim in your README and doc comments against the code, fixes the ones that are no longer true, and cites the line of code that proves each fix.

plugins.name: test-in-browser
plugins.description: Opens your web app in a real browser through the Playwright MCP server, tests its flows, reports what broke, and writes Playwright tests that run in CI.

plugins.name: fresh-eyes
plugins.description: A reviewer subagent that never saw the code being written: it checks every rule in the task against the change, with file, line and proof.
